question: We define a set \(\{f_1,f_2,\ldots,f_n\}\) of polynomials to be a linearly dependent set if there exist real numbers \(c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_n\), not all zero, such that \(c_1f_1(x)+\cdots+c_nf_n(x)=0\) for all real numbers \(x\). Which of the following is a linearly dependent set?

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
